The *Sodhanahāravibhaṅga* ("Conveying a Clearing Up: Analysis") constitutes the sixteenth section (Ne 16) of the *Nettippakaraṇa* in the Pali canon. It presents an analytical treatment of the interpretive mode or conveyance known as *sodhana-hāra* within the hermeneutical framework of the *Netti*.
